3.
This is an admitted appeal.
4. List on 16.04.2026 for final hearing.
Heard on Bail Application No. 1 of 2025 5.

According to the prosecution case, in the intervening night of 02/03.08.2021, when the informant was sleeping with her physically challenged daughter, who was 13 years of age, at about 2:15, the appellant entered into the house and tried to lift and take away the victim, who is daughter of the informant.
Suddenly, the informant noted it, she raised the alarm, thereafter, the appellant left the victim and ran away.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant was on bail during trial.
It is a case of false implication.

The informant had an illicit relation with one Baldev Singh, who was accused in some other cases, in which case the family members of the appellant are witnesses and in one case,
the sister of the appellant had filed a case under the Act against Baldev Singh, the husband of the informant.
They are inimical for a long.
7. Learned State counsel submits that PW2, the informant has supported the prosecution.
The victim is unable to speak, she could not state.
The prosecution has been able to prove its case against the appellant.
8. PW2, the mother of the victim has stated as to what had happened on the date of incident.
According to her, the appellant had held the victim by pressing his hands around her.
He was trying to move the victim and on raising alarm, the appellant ran away.
PW2, the informant has been cross examined, but she has not been cross examined about any enmity etc.
9. Having considered, this Court is of the view that there is not ground to enlarge the appellant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application deserves to be dismissed.
10. The bail application is dismissed.
